claude_proposed_widenings.name: non_reaction_triggered_item_ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Resist Enchantment is a trigger-bound item property, but the existing non-spell triggered family requires consuming a Reaction and would misencode the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_triggering_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can reflect or negate a triggering spell, but it cannot change the triggering saving throw's outcome from failure to success.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can turn your failed save into a successful one
